title: Create src/lib/progress/calculator.ts — compute progress stats
description: Create a pure function that computes overall and per-category progress stats from a task array. Returns a typed ProgressStats object.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns correct overall percent for mixed complete/incomplete tasks
Returns correct per-category breakdown with complete/total counts
Handles empty task array without throwing (returns 0% overall)

steps.details: Create directory src/lib/progress/ and the file. Define: export type CategoryStats = { complete: number; total: number; percent: number }. export type ProgressStats = { overall: { complete: number; total: number; percent: number }; byCategory: Record<string, CategoryStats> }

export function calculateProgress(tasks: Task[]): ProgressStats { if (tasks.length === 0) return { overall: { complete: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 }, byCategory: {} }; const complete = tasks.filter(t => t.passes).length; const overall = { complete, total: tasks.length, percent: Math.round(complete / tasks.length * 100) }; const byCategory: Record<string, CategoryStats> = {}; for (const task of tasks) { if (!byCategory[task.category]) byCategory[task.category] = { complete: 0, total: 0, percent: 0 }; byCategory[task.category].total++; if (task.passes) byCategory[task.category].complete++ }; Object.values(byCategory).forEach(c => c.percent = Math.round(c.complete / c.total * 100)); return { overall, byCategory } }

technicalNotes: This is a pure function — no file I/O, easy to test
